title: FAQs — Two Oceans Marathon
claims: The final cut-off for the 56 km Ultra Marathon is 7 hours from the start gun time of the last batch.
The time-of-day cut-off is determined by the starting time-of-day of the last batch and the cut-off time for 56 km to the finish line.
The Ultra and Half Marathons both start on Main Road, Newlands, and both finish at the University of Cape Town.
Parking details are posted on the website, and tickets for reserved parking are available through the entry system and at Race Pack Collection.
The FAQs do not publish the 2027 intermediate cut-off positions or clock times; they refer readers to the route map.
